FINAL CI VERDICT on change 1234 patchset 1 (run 30771131391, completed): 14 of 15 jobs
SUCCESS, 1 failure. The sole failure is `pip-audit`, and `Verified -1` followed from it.

FULL PYTEST MATRIX GREEN — including py3.11, the CI baseline this host cannot run locally
(3.13/3.14 only):
  success  pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.11)
  success  pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.12)
  success  pytest (ubuntu-latest, py3.13)
  success  pytest (macos-latest,  py3.13)
Also green: lint + type-check, verify-identity, require resolvable rebar ticket,
golden-path (clean install), optionality (both jobs), artifact-probe, eval-discipline,
clear Verified.

THE ONE RED, verified from THIS run's own log rather than inferred:
  pip-audit attempt 1/3
  click 8.2.1   PYSEC-2026-2132   8.3.3   Pallets Click, versions 8.3.2 and below,
    contain a command injection vulnerability in the click.edit() function …
  ##[error]pip-audit found dependency vulnerabilities (see output).
Attempt 1 of 3 SUCCEEDED in reaching the advisory DB, so this is a genuine finding and NOT
the network-flake case the workflow reserves `recheck` for. I did not comment `recheck`,
because it would not clear it and would only add noise to the change.

So the Verified -1 is fully attributable to [rebar:e47e-a33d-b9cf-4421] and NOT to this
story's diff (two new test files + one source comment; no dependency pin, manifest or lock
touched). Every gate that can actually validate this change passed.

STATE: change 1234 is complete and needs no rework from this story. It becomes submittable
once e47e lands and CI is re-triggered (or an administrator overrides the gate). LLM-Review
had not yet voted at time of writing. Ticket stays in_progress — AGENTS.md requires the
change Verified +1 and merged before a close, and a completion-verifier pass is explicitly
not a substitute for green CI.
